description: Fields of the closure record; one schema serves every unit (state.md#2.8). Path cycles/<cycle>/units/<workflow>[.<subject>].json.

schema.description: Format version; 1 in the design's example.

subject.description: Empty for a unit with no subject.

state.description: open from admission or the first stage until the unit closes.

position.description: For a story: one of the positions of topic:story-life.

stages.description: One entry per stage, in the order the stages finished.

verdict.description: The verdict in the unit's closure record: 'perimeter, commit, passes, outcome, and the counts of advisory, dismissed and waived findings' (state.md#2.8, the convergence record row). The design's example writes waived as a list; this schema types the three counts as integers, and head is the commit the verdict covers.

patch_id.description: git patch-id of the diff the verdict covers.

branch.description: The branch the story is delivered to.

base.description: The commit the story branch was cut from; written when the branch is created (topic:worktrees).

pr.description: The pull request link; empty in local mode.

merged_sha.description: Empty until the story is merged; its presence is what makes the story done.

admitted_by.description: How the story became ready: plan, or the run that admitted it through vsdd gate plan --story or vsdd story new-fix.

decision.description: The id of the decision that closed or blocks the unit; null when there is none.

closed.description: ISO 8601, UTC; empty while the unit is open.

waves.description: In the plan's closure record: the map from wave to story ids that vsdd plan schedule computed.

flaky.description: In a story's record, a wave's record and verify.json: the identities of inherited tests a gate recorded as flaky, copied from the gate's evidence.

baseline.description: In the baseline record, cycles/_standing/units/ingest.json or import.json (state.md#2.8): a baseline object.

x-notes: Beyond the common shape: the plan's closure record also holds waves; a wave's record holds its stories and its gate rounds; verify.json holds the checks per round and the properties proven; a story's record, a wave's and verify.json also hold flaky; the baseline record is a closure record with a baseline object.

The baseline object holds: the integration head it was measured on; any earlier release tag; the suite result with the identities of the tests that failed; the lint and format findings; the mutation score per module; the scanner findings in existing dependencies; the recovered or imported contract ids; and whether the project has a suite, a JUnit report and CI.
